objective: Check internal consistency of recovered D1-03 v1 before resuming implementation or experiments
completion_criteria: Check declared clean-case success criterion against admitted transfer-failure branch and unchanged consumer source
Check whether a mandatory coverage policy has independent provenance rather than equating every permission with an obligation
Record source locations, hashes, limits and a concrete recommendation; stop if policy, criteria or budget must change

limits.diagnostic: At most one exhaustive two-row Boolean truth table for ok_j, conditional on a matching burn attempt. This is protocol logic only, not a producer/consumer satisfiability result.

no_changes: Do not revise v1, implement new policy, suppress DEFER, restrict states after seeing results, or manufacture a whole-system verdict. Original three verdicts unchanged.
